scripts.text:
[Canell]
It's well known that we must
be beautiful to captivate those
who watch us dance. But to rely
on just our outward appearance
is a ghastly waste of our full
potential as performers.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
众所周知，我们必须美丽，才能迷住观看我们舞蹈的人。
但仅仅依赖外表，
是对我们作为表演者全部潜力的可怕浪费。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Yes, I can tell that you
don't quite understand that
the correct frame of mind is
an essential element to true
beauty. Now tell me, are you
confident in your dancing...?
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
是的，我能看出你并不完全理解，
正确的心态是真正美丽的必要要素。
现在告诉我，你对自己的舞蹈有自信吗...？

scripts.text: Of course, old crone!
scripts.translation: 当然，老太婆！

scripts.text: I... I'm not sure...
scripts.translation: 我...我不太确定...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Ho-ho~ I believe you've
confused confidence with
arrogance! The naive cannot
tell there's a vitally important distinction between the two.
Now... Prepare for punishment!
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
呵呵~ 我相信你把自信和傲慢搞混了！
天真的人无法分辨这两者之间至关重要的区别。
现在... 准备接受惩罚吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ow...!
Th-that whip!
I-i-it huuuurts!

[Canell]
Awareness of your own flaws
and faults is the first crucial
step towards improvement.
Yet your obvious neglect of
your gift of dancing is...
grounds for punishment!
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
意识到自己的缺陷和错误，
是迈向进步的关键第一步。
然而，你显然忽视了你舞蹈的天赋，这是...
惩罚的理由！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the...? Ack!
S-stop wh-whipping
me! It... It stiiings!

[Canell]
Ho-ho~! Fortunately for
you, I will teach you what
you must learn to rise above
your current limitations. When
I'm finished with you, angels and demons won't resist your charms~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
呵呵~！幸运的是，
我会教你必须学习的东西，以超越你目前的局限。
当我教完你之后，天使和恶魔都无法抗拒你的魅力~

scripts.text: No way, you're not teaching me!
scripts.translation: 没门，我才不学！

scripts.text: Alright, I'll see what I can learn.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我看看能学到什么。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
So... You still haven't
mastered the fine art of
exuding charm and humility!
There must be consequences
for this blatant affront to our
profession! Prepare yourself!
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
所以... 你还没有掌握散发魅力和谦逊的精髓！
这种对我们职业的公然冒犯必须付出代价！
准备接受惩罚吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Nooooo--!
Not that whip
again! Arrgh, it's--
It hurts so much!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不——！
又是那条鞭子！
啊，好——
好痛！

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Ho-ho~ It's good that you
recognize that you have much
to learn. Well, let's not waste
any time. Your first lesson will be on image training and self
visualization. Now, for that...
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
呵呵~ 很好，你认识到自己还有很多要学的。
那么，别浪费时间了。你的第一课是形象训练和自我想象。
现在，为了这个...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
...You must bring
me ^FF00001 Crystal Mirror^000000!
This tool is imperative
to the lesson, so fetch it
and bring it to me quickly!
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
...你必须给我带^FF00001个水晶镜子^000000！
这个工具对课程至关重要，
所以快去拿，然后马上带给我！

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Finally, you've come
with the mirror. Now,
look deeply and scrutinize
your reflection. Gaze upon
each blemish and fault, each
charming trait of your face.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
终于，你带着镜子来了。现在，
仔细审视你的倒影。凝视每一个瑕疵和缺点，
以及你脸上每一个迷人的特征。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
No face is perfect, but
know that your face is yours
alone, and that it is what gives you a beauty that can be no
one else's. Now, repeat
these truisms after me...
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
没有完美的脸，但要知道，
你的脸只属于你，
正是它赋予了你独一无二的美丽。现在，跟着我重复这些真理...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
''I am beautiful...
I am irresistable...''
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
“我是美丽的...
我是不可抗拒的...”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am beautiful...
I am irresistable...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是美丽的...
我是不可抗拒的...

scripts.text:
[Intoxicated Canell]
Louder!
More feeling!
''I am beautiful!
I am irresistable!
I am the most attractive
woman in the whole world!''
scripts.translation:
[酩酊大醉的 卡内尔]
大声点！
更有感情！
“我是美丽的！
我是不可抗拒的！
我是世界上最迷人的女人！”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am beautiful!
I am irresistable!
I am the most attractive
woman in the whole world!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是美丽的！
我是不可抗拒的！
我是世界上最迷人的女人！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYour self esteem has
sky rocketed. Fortunately,
you've managed to avoid
becoming a prima donna.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你的自信心直线上升。幸运的是，
你还没有变成那种难伺候的公主。^000000

scripts.text:
[Frustrated Canell]
Did I tell you to come
back here without bringing
^FF00001 Crystal Mirror^000000!? Now go
and get it before I find
reason to punish you!
scripts.translation:
[沮丧的 卡内尔]
我让你回来时带上^FF00001 水晶镜子^000000了吗！？
现在快去把它拿来，
否则我就找理由惩罚你！

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Yes, the first and most
important step to becoming
beautiful is to realize and
accept your gorgeousness.
Confidence first, then beauty.
Never the other way around.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
是的，变得美丽的第一步，
也是最重要的一步，
就是意识到并接受自己的美貌。
自信在先，美丽在后。
绝不能本末倒置。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Now that you've established
the proper attitude on beauty,
it's time for you to learn an
advanced technique of- shall
we say- enticement. I know an
expert that I highly recommend.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
既然你已经确立了正确的美学态度，
是时候学习一种高级技巧了——
姑且称之为“魅惑”吧。
我认识一位非常推荐的大师。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Go and find my sister
in Prontera Chruch. If you
mention me by name, she
should be willing to teach
you. I'd do it myself, but I need to enjoy my new Crystal Mirror~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
去普隆德拉教堂找我的姐姐。
如果你提到我的名字，
她应该会愿意教你。
我自己也想教，但我得享受我的新水晶镜子~

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt figures that she'd
keep your mirror.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看来她会把你的镜子收着呢。^000000

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Ah, such a glamorous
face and figure. My
beauty is incompara--
Oh! It's you. So did my
sister in Prontera Church
teach you anything yet?
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
啊，多么迷人的脸庞和身材。我的美貌是无与伦比的——
哦！是你啊。那么，普隆德拉教堂的姐姐教你了吗？

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Ah, so were you
able to find Aelle?
Were you able to learn
anything from her?
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
啊，那你找到艾勒了吗？
你从她那里学到什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I only learned
about winks, but not so
much as how to do them.
She... She got drunk and
couldn't teach me more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，我只学到了关于眨眼的知识，
但没学到怎么眨眼。
她...她喝醉了，
没法教我更多了。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Oh, I should have known
this would happen. Oh,
well, I guess there's no way
around it now. But you should
know that gettng my sister
drunk... is punishable.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
哦，我就知道会发生这种事。唉，
算了，现在也没办法了。但你应该知道，
让我姐姐喝醉...是要受罚的。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Bam!
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
啪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
?!
What the
hell was that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
？！
那是什么鬼东西？

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Now, a true Dancer should
be able to figure out the
secret to winking on her
own. But since I'm such
a kind woman, I will deign
to explain it to you. Ho-ho~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
好了，真正的舞娘应该能自己悟出眨眼的秘诀。
但既然我这么善良，我就大发慈悲地解释一下吧。呵呵~

scripts.text:
^3355FFKind woman...?
But she just hit you!
Lightly, of course, but
still, a smack is a smack.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF善良的女人...？
但她刚才打你了！
虽然很轻，但打就是打。^000000

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Alright, the secret to
proper winking is to allow
your eyelid to seductively
move to a natural rhythm.
Close your eye for a second, then open it slowly to this count.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
好了，正确眨眼的秘诀，
是让眼睑以自然的节奏
充满诱惑力地移动。
闭上一只眼睛一秒，然后慢慢睁开，跟着数。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Un, deux, trois~
Look at me, do it
like this. Un, deux, trois~
Now, let me see you try it.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
一，二，三~
看着我，像这样。一，二，三~
现在，让我看看你试试。

scripts.text: Un deux trois~-
scripts.translation: 一 二 三~

scripts.text: Un, doux trois~
scripts.translation: 一，二，三~

scripts.text: Un, deux, trois~
scripts.translation: 一，二，三~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
No, no!
That's wrong,
completely wrong!
Can't you do it right?!
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
不，不！
错了，
完全错了！
你就不能做对一次吗？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
O-ow!
P-please...!
Not the whip again!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好...好痛！
求...求你...！
别再拿鞭子抽我了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Un, deux, trois~

[Canell]
Great, that's exactly
how you do it. Now,
don't forget, the elements
of rhythm and naturalness
are absolutely essential to
this technique of enticement.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
很好，就是这样。
记住，节奏感和自然感
是这项魅惑技巧的绝对要素。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Now that you've mastered
the art of winking, you.
should know that you cannot
allure those who are much
stronger than you. So your
winks won't work on everyone.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
既然你已经掌握了
眨眼的艺术，
你就应该知道，
你无法魅惑比你强大得多的人。
所以，你的眨眼对所有人都不起作用。

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Of course, my winks don't
have that drawback. Ho-ho~
Anyway, it's time for us to part now. I hope that you grow to
become a more glamorous and charming dancer in days to come.
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
当然，我的眨眼没有这个缺点。呵呵~
好了，我们要分别了。希望未来
你能成长为更迷人、更有魅力的舞娘。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have finally learned
the Charming Wink skill.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你终于学会了
眨眼之诱技能。^000000

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Hm...?
Is there anything
more you wanted to
ask me? Ah, you must
be mesmerized by my
beauty, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
嗯...？
还有什么想问我的吗？
啊，你一定是被我的
美貌迷住了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Oh, to be so beautiful
must be a sin! I should
work in Prontera Church,
just like my sister, to
pray for forgiveness~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
哦，长得这么漂亮
一定是种罪过吧！我应该
像我姐姐一样在普隆德拉教堂工作，
祈求宽恕~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Hm? Oh, I remember you!
A Gypsy now, I see~ That
look suits you. Now, I'm
sure you've forgotten a few
things since transcending,
am I right? Watch this wink...
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
嗯？哦，我想起来了！
现在是冷艳舞姬了呢~
这个造型很适合你。我想你转职后
肯定忘了不少东西，对吧？看好了，这个眨眼...

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Remember now? It's all
in the natural, seductive
and rhythmic movement of
the eyelid. I hope you use
your Charming Wink to let
your inner beauty shine~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
想起来了吗？关键在于
眼睑自然、诱惑且富有节奏感的运动。
希望你能用眨眼之诱
展现你内在的美~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have learned the
Charming Wink skill.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你学会了
眨眼之诱技能。^000000

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Oh, you're such an
adorable little girl! Ah,
I'm sorry, but when you
become a lady at, oh, I don't
know, Job Level 40, then I'll
be able to teach you something~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
哦，你真是个可爱的
小女孩！啊，
抱歉，但等你到了，嗯，
职业等级40，成为一位女士时，
我就能教你一些东西了~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Oh, what a cute
little girl~! Such
a chubby lil' belly,
so cuuuuuuuuuuute~
scripts.translation:
[卡内尔]
哦，多么可爱的
小女孩~！
这么圆滚滚的小肚子，
好...好...可...爱...~

scripts.text:
[Canell]
Hey there,
handsome~
^333333*Wink~*^000000

^3355FFStrangely enough,
her wink has made
your heart throb.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF奇怪的是，
她的眨眼让你的心
怦怦直跳。^000000

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Pssst, hey! I got
some cheap, but slightly
illegal, warps to the Orc
Dungeon, Glast Heim
and the Dead Pit. So
you want in on this?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嘘，嘿！我搞到了
一些便宜但有点非法的传送，
去兽人地下城、格拉斯特海姆
和死坑。你想参与吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, um, I'm here
to look for somebody.
You wouldn't happen
to know Canelle's
sister, would you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其实，嗯，我是来
找人的。
你碰巧认识卡内尔的
姐姐吗？

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Ah, so my stuck up
sister sent you, huh?
I should have known,
judging from your clothes.
So you want to become a
more alluring performer, eh?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
啊，原来是我那个
高傲的姐姐派你来的啊？
看你的穿着我就知道了。
所以你想成为
更有魅力的表演者，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Awww...
That's disappointing.
So... You didn't come
here to buy these warps?
You sure you don't want any?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哎呀...
真让人失望。
那么...你不是来买这些传送的？
你确定不要吗？

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Okay, okay...
So you came for me to
teach you some enticement
technique or something, right?
Huh. Well, this lecture I give?
It's long and complicated.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
好好好...
所以你是来找我
教你一些魅惑技巧的，对吧？
哼。不过，我这堂课
可是又长又复杂的。

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Talking and explaining
all of the intricate details
for so long will definitely
parch my throat. So first, you
gotta bring me a refreshing
drink before we can begin...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
要是把那些错综复杂的细节
都讲一遍，我的喉咙肯定会干渴的。
所以，在开始之前，
你得先给我弄点清爽的饮料...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Okay.
Alright, I guess
I can spare a potion
or two, or maybe bring
back a bottle of juic--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...好的。
好吧，我想我可以
拿出一两瓶药水，
或者带瓶果汁回来--

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Whoa, whoa, none of
that junk! I want to
have a real drink.
You know, something
more... ^FF0000Alcohol^000000ic.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哇，别，那种垃圾不要！
我要喝真正的酒。
你知道的，那种
更... ^FF0000酒精^000000含量高的。

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Oh, and I need some
snacks to sustain all of
my teaching energy! Yeah,
some yummy fruit on a plate
and some cookies too!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哦，我还需要一些零食
来补充我教学的能量！
对，盘子里放些美味的水果，
再加点饼干！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Soooo, I wanna eat
^FF00001 Apple^000000, ^FF00003 Bananas^000000 and
^FF00005 Well-Baked Cookies^000000. Ah,
make sure you bring ^FF0000China^000000
to serve them on, and don't
forget the ^FF0000Alcohol^000000, okay?

[Aelle]
One last thing...!
Don't let anyone here
in the church know what
we're doing. I don't wanna
get in too much trouble!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
最后一件事...！
别让教堂里的任何人
知道我们在做什么。
我可不想惹太多麻烦！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Great, you've brought
the food! It's a good thing
I'm famished because
I'm going to finish it all!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
太好了，你把食物带来了！
幸好我饿坏了，
因为我要把它们全部吃光！

scripts.text:
^3355FFAelle devoured the
food like a ravenous,
hungry beast that had
been deprived for too long.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF艾勒像一只饥饿已久的野兽，
狼吞虎咽地吃光了食物。^000000

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
That was sooo good!
I haven't eaten so much
in such a long time! Then
again, you don't get many
chances to pig out in church.
Ah, that's right, the lesson!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
太好吃了！
我好久没吃这么多了！
不过话说回来，在教堂里
很少有机会大吃一顿。
啊，对了，课程！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Now, the easiest, most
subtle and most appealing
gesture of all time is the
^FF0000wink^000000. It's saved me in times
of crisis, and mastering it
will enhance your charms.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
现在，最简单、最微妙
也最迷人的动作就是
^FF0000眨眼^000000。它曾在危机时刻救过我，
掌握它将会提升你的魅力。

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
To the untrained eye,
the wink only looks like
a simple movement, right?
You close one eye, and then
you reopen that eye. But if
you do it right... If you...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
对于未经训练的人来说，
眨眼看起来只是一个简单的动作，对吧？
你闭上一只眼睛，然后再睁开。但如果
你做对了...如果你...

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Oh, it's been so long
since I've had so much
to drink! Ugh, f-feeling
kinda--anyway, j-just close
and yer-- ^333333*burp*^000000 winking
is so so so so eeeeeasy~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哦，我已经很久没有
喝这么多酒了！唔，感-感觉有点--总之，只-只需闭上
再-- ^333333*打嗝*^000000 眨眼是
非常非常非常非常简-单-的~

scripts.text:
[Drunken Aelle]
Do it! Copy me as
I do it! Wink, j-just
like this, okay? Y' see?
^333333*Wiiiiiiiiiiiiiink*^000000
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的 艾勒]
做吧！像我这样
模仿我！眨眼，就-就像这样，好吗？看到了吗？
^333333*眨-眼-~*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wh-whoa...
That was...
It's so beautiful!
And all with just
a simple wink!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇-哇...
那真是...
太美了！
仅仅是一个简单的眨眼！

scripts.text:
[Totally Drunk Aelle]
Y-yea... The...
The secret ish...
*Urp* It'sh in the--
Bwahahahaahah!
It's all spinning!
scripts.translation:
[烂醉的 艾勒]
是-是的...那个...
秘密是...
*嗝* 它在于--
哇哈哈哈！
一切都转起来了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIn her drunken stupor,
Aelle pummels you with
her fists and laughs
maniacally to herself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF在醉意朦胧中，
艾勒用拳头捶打你，
并对着自己狂笑。^000000

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
How can you expect
me to teach you anything
if I faint in the middle of
the lesson? That's right,
I'll need some nourishing,
yet delicious, snacks to eat~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
如果我在讲课中途晕倒，
你怎么指望我教你任何东西？
没错，我需要一些
既营养又美味的零食来吃~

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Soooo, I wanna eat
^FF00001 Apple^000000, ^FF00003 Bananas^000000 and
^FF00005 Well-Baked Cookies^000000. Ah,
make sure you bring ^FF0000China^000000
to serve them on, and don't
forget the ^FF0000Alcohol^000000, okay?

[{0}]
You still haven't told
me the secret to making
a simple wink have so
much provocative charm.
I really need to--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你还没告诉我，
如何让一个简单的眨眼
拥有如此诱人的魅力。
我真的需要--

scripts.text:
[Totally Hammered Aelle]
ZzzZzz... Huh?
Yesh, I know, I'm...
I'm a geeenius, yeah...
...ZzzzZzzzZzZzzzZZZzz...
scripts.translation:
[不省人事的 艾勒]
ZzzZzz...嗯？
是的，我知道，我是...
我是天才，是的...
...ZzzzZzzzZzZzzzZZZzz...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wake up!
I went through
all this trouble to
learn this technique!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
快...快醒醒！
我费了这么大劲
才学会这项技巧！

scripts.text:
[Annoyed Aelle]
SHADDUP!
I'M SHLEEEEEPY!
G-go away. Talk to
Canell, my sister...
...ZzzzzZzZZZzzzZZ....
scripts.translation:
[恼火的 艾勒]
闭嘴！
我困死了！
走...走开。去找我
妹妹卡内尔吧...
...ZzzzzZzZZZzzzZZ....

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Aelle, I really
need you to teach
me everything else
I need to know about
winking and--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
艾勒，我真的
需要你教我
关于眨眼技巧的
其他所有知识，还有--

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
^333333*Hiccup*^000000 Zzz--wha?
I need ta teach you
to go'way. Talk to my
sister, too tired now.
Go lemme alone girl!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
^333333*打嗝*^000000 Zzz--什么？
我得教你怎么滚蛋。去找我
妹妹吧，我现在太累了。
别缠着我了，女孩！

scripts.text:
[Sober Aelle]
Ohhh...
H-headache...
scripts.translation:
[清醒的 艾勒]
噢...
头好痛...

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Oh, wow, look at you!
I can tell that you've
become much more
beautiful. Yes, you're
more elegant and refined
than I can remember.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哇，看看你！
我看得出你变得
更漂亮了。是的，你比
我记忆中的样子
更优雅、更精致。

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Always believe in your
beauty, wield your charm
like a weapon... And anything
you desire in this world can
be yours! Bwahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
永远相信你的美丽，
像使用武器一样
运用你的魅力...
这样，这个世界上
你想要的任何东西
都能属于你！哇哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Pssst, hey! I got
some cheap, but slightly
illegal, warps to the Orc
Dungeon, Glast Heim
and the Dead Pit. So
you want in on this?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嘘，嘿！我搞到了
一些便宜但有点非法的传送，
去兽人地下城、格拉斯特海姆
和死坑。你想参与吗？

scripts.text:
[??????]
Sister Aelle...
Are you still trying
to sell illegal warps
again? Sister Aelle?
scripts.translation:
[??????]
艾勒姐姐...
你又在试图
贩卖非法传送服务吗？
艾勒姐姐？

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Oh crap, it's the pastor!
Shhh, if anybody asks you,
I wasn't doing anything!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
糟糕，是牧师来了！
嘘，如果有人问起，
就说我什么都没做！

scripts.text:
[Aelle]
Thanks, hon...
I know you can
keep my contraband
our little secret. ^333333*Wink*^000000
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
谢了，亲爱的...
我知道你能
替我保守这个
关于违禁品的小秘密。^333333*眨眼*^000000
